report.name: desktop-orbit-greedy
report.title: Reinforcement Learning for Orbital Transfers at the 2026 AI Winter School (Brown University) | James Verbus
report.text:
Try it: fly the transfer yourself#

Use the burn controls to transfer from the circular orbit at r₁ = 1 to a circular orbit at r₂ = 1.6. Run Hohmann executes the two-burn solution, with Δv ≈ 0.207; Run Greedy uses a feedback controller. Compare their burn histories and accumulated Δv.

This browser simulator applies impulses along or opposite the velocity, which can include a radial component. The PPO notebook instead applies impulses along the local orbital tangent. PPO training and policy rollouts are provided in the notebook.

ORBIT VIEW · DOTTED ARC: HOHMANN TRANSFER

▼ Retrograde

Run Hohmann

report.name: desktop-lux-demo
report.title: Calibrating the LUX Dark Matter Experiment | James Verbus
report.text:
Try it: the kinematics behind the energy scale#

Drag the two interaction vertices to change the neutron scattering angle. The diagram calculates recoil energy from the angle and the 2.45 MeV incident neutron energy using two-body elastic scattering kinematics. Small angles correspond to recoil energies below 1 keV; a 180-degree backscatter gives the maximum energy of about 74 keV.

TPC SIDE VIEW · DASHED: INCOMING 2.45 MEV BEAM
RECOIL ENERGY VS. Θ · LOG SCALE · SHADED: SUB-KEV
Reset

Recoil energy between 1 and 10 keV.

θ = 25.2° · first recoil Eᵣ = 3.58 keV · scattered neutron 2446 keV

Drag scatter 1 along the beam line and scatter 2 within the volume. The marker on the curve follows the selected geometry.

report.name: desktop-eif-demo
report.title: Extended Isolation Forest for Distributed Spark/Scala Anomaly Detection | James Verbus
report.text:
Try it: retrain both models live#

These JavaScript implementations train standard Isolation Forest on the left and fully extended EIF on the right using the same points. Each tree uses a subsample of up to 256 points, with path-length normalization based on the actual subsample size. Add points to compare the resulting score maps.
